Accessibility

We want every student in IS445 (Data Visualization) to be able to use the course materials. We measure the course against the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.1, Levels A and AA, and keep two reports:

  • Course website report: this website, including the syllabus, lecture slides, and notebooks.
  • PrairieLearn content report: the quizzes, labs, homeworks, and final project delivered through PrairieLearn.

If anything in the course is a barrier for you, please contact the instructor at jnaiman@illinois.edu. You do not need to wait for a fix to be published.

What the statuses mean

“Tracked items” are the rows of the tables in each report: one per WCAG criterion, plus one per slide deck or question that needs attention.

  • To do a known problem that nobody has started fixing. In the tables, write s="todo".
  • In progress a fix has been started but is not finished. Write s="progress".
  • Needs check no known problem, but the rating has not been confirmed by testing. Write s="check".
  • Done fixed or confirmed. Write s="done".
  • No action nothing to do. Write s="none".
